text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Hmph... Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel her fighting spirit...!!
...But I'm not scared anymore! Because—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina's Family
text_block_list.text:
Verxina~~~~!!
Verxina-chaaan!
Big sisss!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Big sis...!!
Go for ittttt!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I hear you! Those precious voices...
If it's for your sake, I—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis will never, eeever...!
Never ever lose!!
—Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (It's so painful, I just want to collapse... But—everyone is watching.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Stand tall and proud!
I'm amazing, I'm strong... That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Believe it.
That you possess this strength, too.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "The top belongs to me...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—Just take a look at me,
and you'll understand!”

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay now, Cheval.
The scary girl is gone."

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...B-Big sis wasn't scared at all!
Because I'm your older sister! Older sisters are strong.
I'm going to protect you two!"

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"‘It's all right, Cheval.
Just follow me.’"

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis will go on ahead.
That way, you won't be scared, right?"

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Trust your big sister!
Here, take my hand—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right.
You were always protecting me..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I am... my sister's little sister.
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if I can become that strong
someday——

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Stronger than Big sis...
Can I become great too...?—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A complete defeat.
—For today, that is.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Gentil-san...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if it seems like it could be swept away by the wind at any moment,
its roots are firmly planted."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
She never falls because she has built a rock-solid foundation.
I see, I have learned a valuable lesson.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
For "someone"... no, for "family."
That too is a source of great strength, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In that case!
All we need to do is keep surpassing it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I simply need to hone my strength further, elevating it to an unshakable height beyond the reach of mere sentiment.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems a fire has indeed been lit under me.
Thanks to you, I can ascend to heights far beyond."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Next time, as a challenger...
I shall take that pinnacle for myself!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I will accept your challenge, as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose every single time,
I will always get back up. I know I canâ

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because...
an older sister will always be an "older sister"!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As long as they are watching,
I can keep fighting.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: In other words—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
There is absolutely no chance
that I will ever break from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You only exert your power for your own sake.
I am not like you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: The one standing at the apex at the very end... will be me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving it everything she had, Verxina claimed victory.
Though battered from head to toe, her presence was still overflowing with nobility—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
I...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Was I... a cool "big sister"?
choice_data_list: ...I'm not the one who should answer that.
...I'm not the one who should answer that.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Big sis!
Sister...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Kya...!
...Fufu, really now—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Embraced by Vivlos and Cheval Grand, Verxina smiled with deep affection—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That very scene proved that she stood at the pinnacle—
that she was a great older sister.
